description: This file defines the `PaymentOrder` class, related functions for querying modes of payment and suppliers, and functions to generate journal entries based on payment order data within the ERPNext financial system.

classes.name: PaymentOrder
classes.description: A document class representing a payment order with submit, cancel, and update status functionalities.

methods.name: on_submit(self)
methods.description: Triggers payment status update when the payment order is submitted.

methods.name: on_cancel(self)
methods.description: Triggers payment status update when the payment order is canceled.

methods.name: update_payment_status(self, cancel=False)
methods.description: Updates the status of associated references based on the current state (submit or cancel).

methods.name: get_mop_query(doctype, txt, searchfield, start, page_len, filters)
methods.description: Retrieves mode of payment options matching a search term for a specific payment order.

methods.name: get_supplier_query(doctype, txt, searchfield, start, page_len, filters)
methods.description: Retrieves supplier options matching a search term with constraints on existing payment references.

methods.name: make_payment_records(name, supplier, mode_of_payment=None)
methods.description: Creates journal entries for a specific payment order, supplier, and mode of payment.

methods.name: make_journal_entry(doc, supplier, mode_of_payment=None)
methods.description: Builds and saves a journal entry document based on the provided payment order and supplier details.

ctags.name: get_mop_query
ctags.pattern: /^def get_mop_query(doctype, txt, searchfield, start, page_len, filters):$/

ctags.name: get_supplier_query
ctags.pattern: /^def get_supplier_query(doctype, txt, searchfield, start, page_len, filters):$/
